Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows elevated creatinine, suggesting impaired renal function, and markedly increased total bilirubin, indicating possible significant liver dysfunction or biliary obstruction. Chloride is mildly elevated and total CO₂ is slightly low, which may reflect a mild metabolic acidosis. Other parameters are within normal limits. Further clinical correlation and additional investigations are recommended.
